summary: Big moves in AI infrastructure and safety this week: the Model Context Protocol shipped its largest revision (stateless core, MRTR, RFC 9207 auth) and Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 posted new coding/agentic SOTA, even as a Princeton/AISI/Stanford study showed frontier agents still fail at open-ended research judgment and a US push to restrict open-weight models gained steam. Physical sciences delivered: IBM/U Chicago claimed verifiable quantum advantage on logical circuits, Starship Flight 13 deployed the first Starlink V3 sats and survived reentry, LONGi hit a 35.5% tandem-cell record, and two gap sub-themes flipped active (iron-air storage via Ore Energy's 1 GWh deal; co-packaged optics via a silicon-photonics mass-production inflection). Bio saw an experiment-guided AlphaFold3 for structural ensembles, a CRISPR RNA-editing immuno-oncology result, and Moderna's mRNA-1010 flu vaccine heading to an Aug 5 FDA decision. New voice: Sayash Kapoor (Princeton, 'AI Snake Oil'); broad-scan adjacents surged in DAC, geothermal, and SMRs.

highlights.title: MCP ships 2026-07-28 spec: stateless core, MRTR, auth hardening
highlights.detail: The Model Context Protocol's biggest revision to date went live July 28, 2026, replacing the stateful session model with a stateless request/response core, adding Multi Round-Trip Requests, header-based routing, cacheable list results, and RFC 9207 auth hardening; all Tier 1 SDKs (TS, Python, Go, C#) updated same day.

highlights.title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5, new SOTA on coding/agentic evals
highlights.detail: Released July 24, 2026, Opus 5 tops Frontier-Bench, CursorBench, ARC-AGI-3 and OSWorld 2.0 at roughly half Fable 5's cost, with a 1M-token context and 'xhigh' reasoning effort; Anthropic also reports it as its most aligned model to date.

highlights.title: Agility Robotics advances SPAC listing, opens Fremont Physical-AI hub
highlights.detail: Agility Robotics' merger with Churchill Capital Corp XI (pre-money ~$2.5B) is progressing toward a 2026 public listing; the company opened a 60,000 sq ft Fremont Physical AI hub, and Digit has logged 65,000+ operating hours across nine customer sites with $300M+ in multi-year orders.

highlights.title: IIHS: Waymo driverless crash rate 68% lower than human drivers
highlights.detail: A new IIHS study (published July 23, 2026) comparing 50M driverless miles to 222B human miles across Phoenix, SF, LA and Austin found Waymo's crash-involvement rate 68% lower overall (85% lower for single-vehicle crashes, 81% lower for injury crashes), while flagging federal crash-reporting data is not yet adequate for monitoring large-scale AV expansion.

highlights.title: FCC adds foreign humanoid/quadruped robots to import Covered List
highlights.detail: On July 28, 2026 the FCC added foreign-produced advanced robotic devices (humanoids and quadrupeds) and connected power inverters to its Covered List, blocking equipment authorization for new imports over supply-chain/cybersecurity risk; a Department of War national-security review can grant conditional approval.

highlights.title: CRISPR RNA-editing tool restores MHC-I, boosts immunotherapy in prostate cancer
highlights.detail: A CRISPR/dCas13-based 3'UTR engineering system reversed SPSB1-driven MHC-I loss in prostate tumors, restoring CD8 T-cell infiltration and sensitizing tumors to checkpoint therapy in mice; published in Nature Biomedical Engineering and covered the week of July 26, 2026.

highlights.title: China's Neuracle performs first commercial invasive BCI implant
highlights.detail: Neuracle Technology implanted its NMPA-approved NEO epidural BCI in a paralyzed patient at Huashan Hospital on July 13, 2026, giving him robotic-glove control via an epidural electrode array.

highlights.title: mRNA melanoma vaccine sustains 49% recurrence-risk cut at 5-year mark
highlights.detail: Five-year follow-up of KEYNOTE-942 showed intismeran autogene (mRNA-4157/V940) plus pembrolizumab maintained a 49% reduction in recurrence/death risk versus pembrolizumab alone in resected high-risk melanoma; published in Journal of Clinical Oncology.

highlights.title: First mRNA flu vaccine (Moderna mRNA-1010) awaits FDA decision Aug 5
highlights.detail: FDA's VRBPAC voted 9-0 (adults 50-64 and 65+) that Moderna's mRNA-1010 seasonal flu vaccine benefits outweigh risks; the PDUFA date is August 5, 2026, which would make it the first licensed mRNA seasonal flu vaccine in the US.

highlights.title: Experiment-guided AlphaFold3 resolves protein structural ensembles
highlights.detail: ISTA researchers extended AlphaFold3 to be guided by NMR, X-ray, and cryo-EM data simultaneously, overcoming its single-conformation limitation and producing measurement-consistent protein structural ensembles; published in Nature Biotechnology and highlighted July 27, 2026.

highlights.title: IBM & U Chicago claim verifiable quantum advantage on logical circuits
highlights.detail: IBM and University of Chicago researchers ran thousands of logical two-qubit operations across error-corrected logical qubits, completing a task claimed infeasible for classical simulation while providing a verifiability criterion combining hardness and result-checking.

highlights.title: Starship Flight 13 deploys first Starlink V3 sats, upper stage survives reentry
highlights.detail: SpaceX's 13th Starship test flight (late July 2026) deployed Starlink V3 satellites and returned an intact upper stage after reentry, yielding heat-shield performance data under elevated dynamic pressure.

highlights.title: LONGi sets 35.5% efficiency record for silicon-perovskite tandem cell
highlights.detail: LONGi's crystalline silicon-perovskite tandem cell hit an ESTI-certified 35.5% conversion efficiency, announced July 14, 2026, up from 35.2% two months earlier, edging toward the tandem theoretical limit.

highlights.title: Silicon photonics foundries hit mass-production inflection for co-packaged optics
highlights.detail: TrendForce (July 30, 2026) reports UMC/SILITH shipped first mass-produced 12-inch silicon photonics wafers and TSMC's COUPE platform entered production, scaling co-packaged optics to relieve interconnect bandwidth limits for AI accelerators.

highlights.title: Ore Energy signs 1 GWh iron-air multi-day storage deal with Dutch utility
highlights.detail: Ore Energy and Budget Thuis announced continental Europe's largest iron-air storage offtake, up to 1 GWh with a 400-MWh first phase for 2028 delivery, targeting multi-day discharge lithium-ion cannot economically match.

highlights.title: LLNL/Pacific Fusion Sirius pulser hits 3,000-shot reliability milestone
highlights.detail: Lawrence Livermore National Lab and Pacific Fusion surpassed 3,000 shots on the Sirius impedance-matched Marx generator, advancing pulsed-power inertial-fusion driver technology under their CRADA.

highlights.title: Study: frontier AI agents fail at genuine open-ended research judgment
highlights.detail: Princeton/UK AISI/Stanford researchers gave frontier AI agents six days and thousands of dollars of compute to pursue two unpublished papers; the agents completed the engineering but were rejected by the original human authors for poor judgment, uncreative problem-solving, and weak backtracking.

highlights.title: Sayash Kapoor — Princeton AI researcher gaining traction on agent evals
highlights.detail: Co-author of 'AI Snake Oil' and of the new study on whether AI agents can conduct real open-ended research; his empirically-grounded critiques of agent capability claims are spreading fast this week.

payload.name: Sayash Kapoor
payload.role: PhD candidate, Princeton CITP; Mozilla Senior Fellow
payload.focus: Empirical evaluation of AI agent capability claims, reproducibility, AI policy
payload.notes: Co-author of 'AI Snake Oil'; this week's paper on AI agents' failure at open-ended research judgment went viral.

highlights.title: Germany's largest direct air capture facility comes online in Berlin
highlights.detail: Siemens and Ucaneo's electrochemical DAC plant, inspired by the human lung, began operating in Berlin, delivering CO2 at over 99.9% purity as DAC deployment activity accelerates.

payload.detail: Electrochemical lung-inspired DAC process commissioned at Germany's largest DAC facility (inaugurated Jul 2, 2026).

highlights.title: Next-gen geothermal starts undercutting nuclear on installed cost
highlights.detail: Fervo's Cape Station Phase 2 is tracking toward roughly $5,500/kW installed while Quaise Energy closed a $134M Series B tranche for superhot-rock geothermal, signaling geothermal's cost trajectory closing in on advanced nuclear.

payload.detail: Fervo and Quaise cost/funding milestones positioning advanced geothermal below nuclear installed cost.

highlights.title: SMR nuclear stocks surge on industry momentum (Oklo, NuScale, X-Energy)
highlights.detail: Shares in Oklo, NuScale, and X-Energy each jumped more than 10% on July 30 amid positive small-modular-reactor news, including Holtec's NRC-approved plan to build four SMRs at the Oyster Creek site.

payload.detail: Nuclear/SMR momentum tied to regulatory and partnership milestones.

highlights.title: Ore Energy — iron-air multi-day storage startup (Delft spinout)
highlights.detail: Dutch iron-air 'rust battery' startup targeting 24-100h multi-day discharge; just signed continental Europe's largest iron-air offtake (up to 1 GWh) with utility Budget Thuis, making it a notable player in the long-duration storage gap.
